sections.title: Marks and reactions
lines: A Setter's hit leaves its element's {Mark} on the boss. The mark strip under the boss shows them all.
Hit the same element again and the mark gains a stack. A boss can carry several marks at once.
A Payoff that hits a mark its element is strong against sets off a {Reaction}: bonus damage.
Each Reaction takes a stack off the mark. When its stacks run out, the mark is gone.
A row acts from the front, left to right. Put the Setter before the Payoff, so the mark is there to cash.

sections.title: Roles and Knacks
lines: A Setter marks, a Payoff cashes marks, a Guard takes hits for those beside it, and a Support boosts and heals them.
Each creature can carry one Knack: a trick picked from the ones its form knows. Evolving can add more.
Choose it on the creature's page. A creature can also go without one.
Once a creature has fought this weekend, its Knack is locked. Choose before stage 1.
Words like {Spend} and {Store} in a Knack's text are keywords. Tap one here to read what it means.

sections.title: The board
lines: Your team stands in rows and columns. Row 1 is the one nearest the boss.
Each row acts from left to right, and the boss takes a turn after every row.
The boss has a plain attack and named moves. A move's tile shows its shape and whom it picks.
The shape says which slots it hits: Slam, Lance, Sweep, Barrage, Quake, Strike, Hush, Pincer or Leap.
The target says whom it picks: Front, Rear, Payoff, Nemesis (the strongest), Vulture (the most hurt) or Wild.

sections.title: Armour and crits
lines: Every creature and every boss has armour, a flat amount taken off each hit.
A hit that does not get past the armour is {Blocked} and deals nothing. Big hits get through where small ones do not.
A {Crit} is a lucky hit that deals a multiple of its damage. A creature's page shows its chance and its multiplier.
Its Knack, talents and gear can raise both.
A Reaction hit can crit too, and its bonus grows with it.

sections.title: The raid weekend
lines: Stage 1 plays on Saturday, stage 2 on Sunday, and the live finale on Sunday evening.
The three stages share one boss. Only HP carries over: marks and the rest start fresh each stage.
A creature that is knocked out is out for the weekend. A spare can take its empty slot before the next stage.
Players lock in when stage 1 begins: whoever is on the board fights, and nobody joins after.
To pair up differently, tap a teammate's creature and Ask to swap. They answer from Home.

sections.title: The Boss Rank
lines: The server meets the bosses in a fixed order, and the Boss Rank counts how far along it is.
Beat the boss and the server moves on to the next one, a Rank higher.
The next boss is known a week ahead, so you can prepare.
A boss you did not beat comes back next week at full HP, with the most you took off it shown as a pale fill.
After the first lap, each failed weekend gives {Determination}: a little more damage and healing.
